description: Delete entries and visitors' uploaded files of one list for good: by `docIds`, by `fileIds`, everything created between `after` and `before` (one bound is enough), or `all`. It cannot be undone; meant to be confirmed with the user first.

all.description: true = every entry and uploaded file of the list

before.description: ISO 8601 time; a range deletes entries and uploaded files alike

manageUrl.description: Management link; replaces namespace, id and ownerToken
